workflows.name: Behavioral Spec Verification Loop
workflows.purpose: Optional mature-repo rehabilitation loop that derives a behavioral spec from code, tracks it in one canonical spreadsheet, tests every story, fixes defects, re-tests, regression-covers, and audits complexity.
output_contract: Gated workflow: disabled by default and eligible only by explicit opt-in or mature project eligibility report.
Canonical artifact: exactly one .xlsx updated in place across all phases and loop iterations; default path .planning/runs/{run_id}/behavioral-spec.xlsx.

Spreadsheet columns: Feature ID | Area | Surface | User story | Persona / role | Auth state | Data precondition | Viewport | Expected behavior from code | User-acceptable behavior | Source files/functions | Test method | Test command/actions | Observed behavior | Status | Defect ID | Defect type | Root cause | Fix summary | Regression test added | Complexity review | Evidence | Iteration | Last tested commit | Open question / notes.

Status flow: Discovered -> Spec'd -> Test-Blocked / Tested-Pass / Tested-Fail -> Fixing -> Fixed -> Verified -> Regression-Covered; additional statuses Needs-Product-Decision, Needs-Environment, Won't-Fix-With-Reason.

No row may be marked Verified unless it has evidence, source file/function citation, test method, exact command or browser action, observed result, iteration number, last tested commit, and no open functional, UX, permission, security, data-integrity, or logistical defect for that story.
No row may be marked Regression-Covered unless the verified behavior has automated regression coverage, or automation is genuinely not feasible and a manual verification note explains why.
Main thread is the single writer to the spreadsheet; subagents may inspect, test, and report but must not mutate the canonical spreadsheet.
Complexity gate: reuse thermo-nuclear-simplification for every fix and record Complexity review as Pass, Fail, or N/A.
Safety cap: stop a story after 3 full fix/re-test iterations, preserve evidence and root-cause notes, then continue other stories when safe.
Final report includes spreadsheet path, current commit, feature counts by status, defects fixed by type, regression tests, commands run, skipped tests, remaining risk, and complexity-gate result.
workflows.purpose_long: Use only for mature, meaningful repos where exhaustive behavioral verification is worth the cost. Small prototypes should receive a lighter smoke, inventory, pre-PR, targeted bugfix, or test-backfill workflow instead.
